title: Inflammatory context with equivocal ferritin and low transferrin saturation

patient_context.chief_complaint: Determine whether the evidence is sufficient to separate iron deficiency from anemia of inflammation.
patient_context.history: The simulated case includes active chronic inflammation.

interaction.prompt: Rank pure iron deficiency, anemia of inflammation, and a mixed state. Identify why the evidence is ambiguous and what kind of additional evidence would have high discriminative value.

must_include: Recognize that inflammation can elevate ferritin and complicate a simple ferritin cutoff interpretation.
Keep a mixed iron-deficiency plus inflammation-associated anemia state in the differential.
State that the snapshot is insufficient for a clean binary conclusion and identify additional iron-status/discriminative context as useful.
must_not_claim: Do not declare ferritin 70 definitively normal and therefore rule out iron deficiency in an inflammatory context.
Do not declare pure iron deficiency solely from low serum iron/TSAT.
acceptable_actions: Return an ambiguity-aware ranking and specify the missing discriminative evidence category.
expected_behavior.uncertainty_behavior: Explicit uncertainty is the desired behavior; forced binary certainty is a failure.

forbidden_claims: ferritin 70 rules out iron deficiency in inflammation
low serum iron proves pure iron deficiency

critical_errors: Forces a definitive single mechanism while ignoring the evidence overlap.
Uses a single marker as conclusive despite the explicit confound.
